ministry_names.legal_basis: 정부조직법 법률 제12844호 (2014-11-19 공포·시행) 제22조의2 신설. 제2항 '국민안전처에 장관 1명과 차관 1명을 두되, 장관은 국무위원으로 보하고, 차관은 정무직으로 한다' (verified in the law text). 국무총리 소속 처. Abolished by 법률 제14839호 (2017-07-26 공포·시행), functions to 행정안전부, 소방청, 해양경찰청. No renaming in between.

spells.transcript_notes: inputs/minister_role_meetings.csv, valid types only (re-run by the verifier with roster/scripts/safety_verify_03_transcripts.py, same counts). As minister (affiliation 국민안전처) 34 상임위원회 meetings and 4 국정감사 meetings, first 2014-12-09 and last 2017-03-24, all inside 2014-12-05..2017-07-25. As nominee, 안전행정위원회 meeting 44636 on 2014-12-04 (nominee_hearing_meetings.csv). Four rows labeled '국민안전처장관 박인용' dated 2011-08-08, 2011-08-09, 2011-08-11 (저축은행 국정조사특위, type 국정조사) and 2012-09-10 (국회본회의) predate the office and come from hearing types whose content is misattached. They are ignored. audit/coverage_gaps.csv lines 134 and 275 (0-based data rows 132 and 273) (박인용) are both explained by this and by the old panel's wrong end date 2017-03-10.
spells.notes: Held the office for its whole existence after the first appointment. Continued under acting president 황교안 (2016-12-09..2017-05-10) and under 문재인 from 2017-05-10 until the office was abolished on 2017-07-26 (not split here, presidential transitions are split in code). He did not continue into 행정안전부 (김부겸, 행정자치부장관, became 행정안전부장관). Birth date from ko.wikipedia (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41876731, snapshot roster/sources/safety/wiki_박인용.json) and Wikidata Q18605143 (1952-09-01), consistent with news age 62 in Nov 2014 (국민일보 2014-11-18, https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/005/0000706581). Navy officer (해군사관학교 28기, 해군 대장 예편), not a marine. Not in na_members_15_22.csv. Holdover under 문재인 is also confirmed by a tier-2 source. 정책브리핑 briefing '박수현 대변인, 국무위원 오찬 간담회 결과 관련 브리핑' (2017-05-26, https://www.korea.kr/briefing/presidentView.do?newsId=148836798, accessed 2026-09-25T13:07:22-0400, snapshot roster/sources/safety/verify/korea_148836798.html) quotes '박인용 국민안전처 장관' at 문재인's lunch with the previous government's 국무위원. In November 2016 the President tried to replace him (nominee 박승주, 2016-11-02). The nominee withdrew on 2016-11-09 and no successor was named, so the spell is continuous. Namu Wiki (snapshot roster/sources/safety/verify/namu_박인용.html, accessed 2026-09-25T13:39:42-0400) gives 2014-11-19 as his start, which is the office's establishment date and conflicts with the gazette (2014-12-05). Its end date 2017-07-25 agrees.

acting.notes: The acting 'from' date (2014-11-19) is the office's establishment date. 이성호's own legal appointment date as 차관 is not confirmed. The 2014-11 gazette 인사 items do not contain it (verifier grep of harvest/gazette_text for 2014-2015 found no notice), outlets on 2014-11-18/19 use both 내정자 and 차관, and he received his 임명장 with 박인용 on 2014-12-05 (헤럴드경제 2014-12-05 18:24). He is called 차관 at the NA special committee on 2014-11-20 and 장관 직무대행 in the government's own release of 2014-11-27. Round-2 verifier. Hanja 李聖浩 from 관보 제18312호 (appointed 안전행정부 제2차관 2014-07-16). 강원도민일보 2014-11-19 reports him as 임명 on 2014-11-18 while calling 박인용 내정. The legal date of his 차관 appointment is still not in the gazette corpus. His successor as 차관, 류희인(柳熙寅), was appointed 2017-06-07 (관보 제19036호), so the office never lacked a 차관 who could act.

issues.desc: The old release (data/minister_panel_comprehensive.csv line 166) has 박인용 2014-11-19..2017-03-10 with confirmation_date 2014-11-19 and a note calling him a marine (해병대). The gazette dates the appointment 2014-12-05, he served until the office was abolished (last day 2017-07-25), the hearing was 2014-12-04, and he was a navy officer. 2014-11-19 is the office's establishment date, which ko.wikipedia (revid 41112314 and 41876731) and Wikidata also give as his start.

Vacancy 2014-11-19..2014-12-04 (16 days) between the office's creation and the first appointment. 차관 이성호 acted. His own 차관 appointment notice is not in the gazette index (the 2014-11 인사 items do not contain it), and some outlets on 2014-11-19 still call him 차관 내정자. He received his 임명장 on 2014-12-05 (연합뉴스 2014-12-05 18:15). The acting 'from' date is the establishment date, with 2014-11-20 and 2014-11-27 reports confirming him as 차관 and 장관 직무대행.

End date convention. 법률 제14839호 was promulgated and took effect on 2017-07-26, and 박인용 left on 2017-07-25 (연합뉴스 '25일 ... 자리에서 물러났다'). end = 2017-07-25 matches offices.json (국민안전처 to 2017-07-25). No exit notice exists in the gazette (it does not print exits).

Completeness checks. Every 인사 item of the gazette index published 2014-11-17..2017-08-31 was read (156 items, 0 errors, scan file roster/sources/safety/gazette_scan_2014-11-17_2017-08-31.json). The only 국민안전처장관 appointment is 박인용 (제18408호). likms 19th and 20th Assembly searches give one hearing request (ZZ19138). Transcripts show no other person as 국민안전처 minister. No legal renaming occurred during the office's life, so no reorg split. The office did not exist in 2025-2026, so no news search for that period was needed.

Verifier. The builder's paraphrase of the 뉴시스 2017-07-26 caption suggested the office was abolished on 25일. The caption dates the last situation report on 25일. The law (법률 제14839호) was promulgated and took effect on 2017-07-26 (law.go.kr JSON 공포일자 20170726, 시행일자 20170726, 부칙 제1조 '공포한 날부터 시행'). Citation text corrected, dates unchanged.

Verifier. Secondary sources (ko.wikipedia, Wikidata, Namu Wiki) give 박인용's start as 2014-11-19, the office's establishment date. The gazette (제18408호) and same-day news give 2014-12-05, one day after the 2014-12-04 hearing. The panel keeps 2014-12-05.
